description: The nightly T3 drift job failed on 2026-10-05 in two steps: submission validator drift and pricing data drift. The validator drift has since cleared (the submission-validator-drift-check push run on 2026-10-08 succeeded). Pricing drift has not: the pricing-data-drift-check push run on 2026-10-08 00:20Z failed with exit code 2, which the workflow reports as upstream vendor prices having moved.
